name: Column Match
summary: A CSV import that reads your real file, wires its columns to contact fields and checks every row
about: Column Match is a three-step contact import. It reads the CSV you drop on your own device, guesses which column is the name, phone, city, email and amount, and draws a coloured wire from each column to its field. The preview cleans the values, flags bad phone numbers and emails, and Import stacks every good row into the pile while the rows that need fixing can be saved as their own CSV.
how: Drop a CSV on the card, press Choose CSV, or press Sample for a list of 18 customers.
Check the wires; change any field with its menu (a column can feed only one field).
Look at the preview: cells that fail a check are marked in amber.
Press Import to stack the good rows, or Download rows to fix to save the rest as a CSV.
